from pathlib import Path
program_path=program_dir/'task-f213f1fd.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Extend matching adjacent diagonal pairs through the background to the edge.
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = out[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, rr, cc, color))
    for r1, c1, r2, c2, color in pairs:
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        for r, c, sr, sc in ((r1, c1, -dr, -dc), (r2, c2, dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = r+sr, c+sc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr, cc = rr+sr, cc+sc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(compile(source,str(program_path),'exec'),ns)
# Recreate observed pairs.
d1=[[0]*14 for _ in range(11)]; d1[3][8:10]=[8,5]; d1[4][8:10]=[8,2]
d2=[[7]*13 for _ in range(19)]; d2[8][7:9]=[9,3]; d2[9][7:9]=[8,6]
d3=[[3]*18 for _ in range(20)]
d3[16][12]=7; d3[17][10:12]=[2,7]; d3[18][10:12]=[8,6]; d3[19][9]=8; d3[19][12]=6

assert ns['transform'](d2)==d2
assert ns['transform'](d3)==out3_expected
